title: AI-BASED EVALUATION OF THE SDGS: THE CASE OF CROP DETECTION WITH EARTH OBSER-VATION DATA
reasoning: The paper discusses the application of AI for Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the "AI for Good movement," which relate to social welfare and ethical applications of technology. However, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics as its primary focus. It applies AI to achieve good outcomes, rather than analyzing the ethical frameworks themselves.
